summary: Tested the Replay MVP without touching the physical device. A Playwright route guard aborted any POST to */replays, and replay-confirm-start was never clicked. BACKEND: the isolated-DB suites test_replay.py, test_api_integration.py and test_units.py passed 35/35. The new read-only external suite test_replay_external.py passed 7/7: replay-target for the real session returns compatible=true with Xiaomi M2101K7BG / ZDEY45NRORWCF6N7, com.amts.sampleapp, com.amts.sampleapp.HomeActivity and stepCount 1, with no private '_' keys leaked; an unknown session returns 404; GET /api/replays/does-not-exist returns 404 REPLAY_NOT_FOUND; the session replays list is a list; agent replay status returns 401 with no token or a bad token; command result returns 401 with no token. FRONTEND: steps-replay-button ('Tekrar Oynat') is enabled for the real session. The confirm dialog shows device 'Xiaomi M2101K7BG', serial ZDEY45NRORWCF6N7, package com.amts.sampleapp, activity '.HomeActivity' and steps '1 × TAP'. Cancel closes it. The Oynatmalar tab shows replay-history-empty. For the Mongo-seeded saved session on an offline device, the button is disabled and steps-replay-button-disabled-reason shows the DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED message; its history row lists the run and navigates to /replays/{id}. A seeded DEMO session has no replay button on either Recorded Steps or Sessions. On Sessions, session-replay-{id} is enabled for the real session, disabled for the offline one and absent for the demo one; the compact dialog opens and cancels. The ReplayRun page for the PASSED synthetic run shows status BAŞARILI, 1/1, step PASSED, locator 'RESOURCE_ID · com.amts.sampleapp:id/transferButton', no error. For the FAILED run it shows BAŞARISIZ, 2/2, step 1 FAILED with an AMBIGUOUS_LOCATOR step error and a run-level replay-error, and step 2 SKIPPED. The back link works, and an unknown run id shows replay-run-error. All synthetic docs (ui-test-* sessions, steps, events, replays) were deleted afterwards. The DB again holds only the real session and 0 replays. No heartbeats were sent, the token was not rotated and the real session was not modified.

minor.issue: start_replay has a check-then-insert race: two concurrent POSTs can both pass active_replay_for_device and queue two START_REPLAY commands for the same device. Use a unique partial index or an atomic upsert/lock per device.serial for active statuses.
The limit query param has no bounds (e.g. limit=0 or a negative or huge value). Add Query(20, ge=1, le=100).
Error messages are English-only and the frontend shows them verbatim in the Turkish UI (steps-replay-button-disabled-reason). Map error.code to i18n keys.

issues: Step status tags (PASSED/FAILED/SKIPPED) are raw English, while the run StatusBadge is localized (BAŞARILI/BAŞARISIZ). This is inconsistent in TR mode.
Each compact ReplayButton polls /replay-target every 5 s independently, so there are N requests per 5 s for N saved sessions. Consider one batched endpoint or polling only while the page is visible.

action_items: Optional: make replay start atomic per device to prevent double-queue races
Optional: bound the limit param on the list replays endpoint
Optional: localize the replay-target error messages and step status tags in TR
critical_code_review_comments: ReplayControls.useReplayTarget polls every 5 s per button instance; Sessions page multiplies requests
ReplayRun back link goes to /recorded-steps/{session_id} even if the session was deleted, which leads to a 404 toast. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Temporary Mongo docs with ids prefixed ui-test-* (2 sessions, 1 step, 1 event, 3 replays) were inserted via /tmp/seed.py and deleted afterwards (verified: replays=0, sessions=[real one only]).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real agent and Xiaomi device are connected. Never POST /api/sessions/9520beae.../replays, never click replay-confirm-start, never send heartbeats, never rotate the token. The read-only external suite is test_replay_external.py (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env). For UI checks, seed ui-test-* docs directly in Mongo and clean them up afterwards. The real end-to-end replay on the device was NOT exercised; only the isolated pytest flows cover the mutation path.
